gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-inria-sans: Chunky pixels, then a soft landing. Inria Sans follows with strokes like bent copper pipe, so a size slightly larger than usual lets its open shapes breathe under the blocky heading.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-istok-web: Istok Web brings rounded letters with a clearly open side, friendly and modern against the heavy pixel look above it. And Pixelify Sans carries the wire-like weight, so the plain sans body can stay at a modest size.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-jost: Blocky, bold and unmistakably digital. Jost answers with broad gaps at its terminals and one uniform stroke throughout, a quiet, tidy partner that lets the pixel heading do the shouting.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-jura: Pixel-built swagger, handed off to something tidy. Jura keeps its strokes as constant as bent wire, and its s curves open wide at both ends, which makes the loud heading feel anchored.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-k2d: Pixelify Sans stamps out bold, expressive letters with a line weight that never varies, and an open c like a bent paperclip. K2D, a plain sans with tube-like strokes, hushes things down beside it.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kanchenjunga: Pixelify Sans arrives loud, blocky and expressive. Kanchenjunga sits underneath with the steady line of a technical drafting pen, so the sans text stays crisp even at low resolution while the heading keeps its attitude.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kantumruy-pro: Kantumruy Pro reads friendly and straightforward, its e opening clearly to the right with no hairlines or swells. Pixelify Sans is the one for bold, expressive display moments, while Kantumruy Pro handles the sans text with approachable ease.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kodchasan: Playful but tidy, this pairing puts a bold, expressive pixel heading over a plain sans whose terminals hang open. And Kodchasan, with no calligraphic thinning, gives the loud top line a steady, uncomplicated partner.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-koho: KoHo is a plain sans with wide c apertures, quiet and easy beside its loud partner. Pixelify Sans keeps every line the same weight on downstrokes too, so a slightly larger KoHo size matches that pixel presence.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kosugi: Pixelify Sans brings bold, expressive pixel letters with a line weight that never wavers. And Kosugi, a sans-serif with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers, keeps a wire-bent look going across every word.
